symbols.name: real numerator part
symbols.meaning: The integer real part of the numerator $a + bi$ of a Gaussian dyadic.
symbols.quote: Here $a$ and $b$ are the integer real and imaginary parts of the numerator $a + bi$, a Gaussian integer (a complex number with integer real and imaginary parts).

symbols.name: imaginary numerator part
symbols.meaning: The integer imaginary part of the numerator $a + bi$ of a Gaussian dyadic.
symbols.quote: Here $a$ and $b$ are the integer real and imaginary parts of the numerator $a + bi$, a Gaussian integer (a complex number with integer real and imaginary parts).

symbols.name: denominator exponent
symbols.meaning: The non-negative integer exponent that sets the common denominator $2^k$.
symbols.quote: The exponent $k$ is a non-negative integer that sets the denominator $2^k$.

symbols.name: two-point map
symbols.meaning: The map that sends a pair of coefficients $u$, $v$ to their halved sum and halved difference.
symbols.quote: A butterfly layer applies the two-point map $H_0$ to pairs of coefficients whose indices differ in one selected bit, sending $u$, $v$ to $\left(\frac{u+v}{2}, \frac{u-v}{2}\right)$.

symbols.name: first coefficient
symbols.meaning: The first coefficient of a pair on which the two-point map $H_0$ acts.
symbols.quote: A butterfly layer applies the two-point map $H_0$ to pairs of coefficients whose indices differ in one selected bit, sending $u$, $v$ to $\left(\frac{u+v}{2}, \frac{u-v}{2}\right)$.

symbols.name: second coefficient
symbols.meaning: The second coefficient of a pair on which the two-point map $H_0$ acts.
symbols.quote: A butterfly layer applies the two-point map $H_0$ to pairs of coefficients whose indices differ in one selected bit, sending $u$, $v$ to $\left(\frac{u+v}{2}, \frac{u-v}{2}\right)$.
